bullets.text: Livestream Brazil vs. Senegal - Watch the international friendly match for free on **ITV** in the UK.
Apple's Legal Woes - **Apple** denied permission to appeal a billion-dollar lawsuit over app developer commissions.
Apple Watch Blood Oxygen Scrutiny - The redesigned blood oxygen feature faces new scrutiny from the **ITC**.
Apple Wallet Upgrades - New features in **Apple Wallet** enhance order tracking and introduce Digital ID.
Deepfake Realism Rising - **Deepfake** videos are becoming more realistic, complicating the distinction between real and AI-generated content.
Tim Cook's Potential Departure - **Tim Cook** may step down as **Apple** CEO next year, with succession plans underway.
Group Chat Feature for ChatGPT - **OpenAI** is piloting a group chat feature for **ChatGPT** in select regions.
Framework Laptop Upgrades - The new **Framework Laptop 16** offers significant upgrades, including a powerful user-replaceable GPU.
